english: From here he looked upon every suffering being, watching the way they were blinded by ignorant liking, and ignorant disliking, and dark ignorance itself.  He saw how their bodies were plagued by a whole range of sicknesses; he saw how they went through the pain of death; he saw how they were hurt by their enemies, and by different forces in lonely and dangerous places.
